definitions.short: Jehallelel , the name of two Israelites
definitions.full: H3094. Yehallelel יְהַלֶּלְאֵל proper name [masculine] ( he shall praise God , compare מַהֲלַלְאֵל below); — 1 a man of Judah 1Chr 4:16 ; 2 a Levite 2Chr 29:12 .
